'''Kirk Murray''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 100th in the Wild Card at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]<ref name="dc99sw01_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW01_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: 1999 SW Wildcard], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011101231420/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW01_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
